forecaster_note: Easing mix of ENE and S swells leaves waist to chest high surf, bigger sets across the S swell magnets. Clean offshores in the morning then light and calm in the arvo — fun enough across the right high tide banks. Wed–Thu: large onshore S swell, not much wrap into sheltered breaks — a day worth giving a miss. Fri: better quality SE swell arrives, well overhead; Sat eases. — Surfline forecaster (Tue 6 Oct)

wind.summary: Light W 6 kph offshore at 6am, ~7 kph at 9am, SW 7–19 kph by noon–3pm (still offshore), E onshore by 6pm. Southerly 33 kph kicks in overnight.

shark.summary: Northern Beaches, last 24h: 3 tagged White Shark #3654 detections at Palm Beach (6:41–7:25am Mon, newest ~23h ago). Nothing at Dee Why, Long Reef, Curl Curl or Manly. Feed current (newest statewide activity <1h old; 57 detections statewide in 24h, mostly Yamba/Hawks Nest/Mid-North Coast). Check the live map before paddling out.
